# CPU-only torch for the Integration Tests job (.github/workflows/test.yml).
#
# The default Linux torch wheel pulls in CUDA and Triton, and Triton's native
# library aborts the test process when transformers imports torch._dynamo in
# the same process as TensorFlow. The CPU wheel has neither.
#
# Locked to one verified wheel: CPython 3.10 (the job's PYTHON_VERSION), Linux
# x86_64. Install with --require-hashes --only-binary :all: --no-deps; torch's
# own dependencies come from the following `pip install -e ".[dev,all]"`.
# To bump: take the new wheel's sha256 from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu/torch/
--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
torch==2.14.1+cpu --hash=sha256:4ce2a6ae7d302bba56ef7c5c92d9f752728896cfe2626a7f3e5293f879e36650
